rules.label: Full charity discount
rules.quote: Federal Poverty Levels based on total household income, with sufficient supporting documentation provided by the patient, will have a 100% Charity discount processed.

rules.label: Expanded financial assistance
rules.quote: For patients whose documented income is between 251 and 400 percent of the Federal Poverty Level, we have an expanded financial assistance policy that may reduce the amount you owe.

rules.label: Uninsured discount
rules.quote: All Self-Pay patients, excluding elective cosmetic procedures and facility designated self-pay flat rate procedures , will receive discount similar to managed care, referred to as an "uninsured discount".

payment_plan.quote: You do not owe any more money after: You make 36 monthly payments, or You pay the full discounted amount in your payment plan.

notes: Medicare accounts and non-Medicare inpatient accounts require supporting income verification documentation.
Some locations may have identified additional criteria for charity eligibility besides the Federal Poverty Levels.
The hospital must see if you qualify for public health coverage and discount programs within 45 days of when you got care if you do not have health insurance.
If you have health insurance, the hospital has 45 days to see if you can get help after you ask them.
After you complete an application, the hospital must tell you if you qualify within 21 days.
You must file your appeal within 30 days of the date the hospital gave you their decision.
r1 may leave out a condition: Requires non-elective care and no qualification for state/federal assistance.
r3 may leave out a condition: Limited to self-pay patients with no third-party payer and not qualifying for other discounts.
